description: Sanctions and PEP screening for one company. entries[] with kind=entity: the company itself on a sanctions list (MSWiA, EU, US, UK, World Bank), matched by KRS, NIP or REGON, with measures and legal grounds. kind=person: board members, proxies, owners and beneficial owners matched to sanctions lists (EU, UN, US, UK, MSWiA) or PEP sources (Sejm, Wikidata, boards of state-owned companies), with list_kind, confidence (confirmed / likely / possible), role in the company, public positions and soe_role. Null when nothing matched. The same payload is included on get_company as sanctions.

krs.description: KRS number of the company in the Polish National Court Register (10 digits).

name.description: Company name, used when the KRS or NIP is not known.

nip.description: Polish company tax number (NIP) of the business, 10 digits.

name: get_company_sanctions
title: Get sanctions and PEP screening
